research_progress.source_confidence_semantics: Heuristic research-source confidence only: direct official GOV.UK, MHCLG/Planning Data and DBT source verification; current 2026 dates where present, policy-vs-permission separation, authoritative-vs-MHCLG/NO_DATA provenance, exact-geometry, local-rule applicability, infrastructure-capacity and macroeconomic-vs-parcel-demand gates. Not parcel-level accuracy.

verification.method: Direct official-web verification plus repository duplicate searches

official_sources.name: Town centres and retail planning guidance
official_sources.gate: Sequential/impact compliance is a decision input, not planning permission or parcel-level development capacity.

official_sources.name: NPPF chapter 7: ensuring the vitality of town centres
official_sources.gate: Policy status does not establish an exact centre boundary, available alternative site or final permission for a target parcel.

official_sources.name: NPPF chapter 6: building a strong competitive economy
official_sources.gate: National support for a sector or use does not prove a particular parcel has planning permission, infrastructure capacity or commercial demand.

official_sources.name: Housing and economic land availability assessment
official_sources.gate: HELAA inclusion or assessed potential must not be promoted to adopted allocation, planning permission or delivery certainty.

official_sources.name: Housing and economic needs assessment
official_sources.gate: Area-level economic need or forecast demand is not proof of parcel-specific occupier demand, viability or permission.

official_sources.name: Healthy and safe communities planning guidance
official_sources.gate: Identified health need or nearby facility does not prove healthcare capacity, funding, delivery timing or parcel suitability.

official_sources.name: NPPF chapter 8: promoting healthy and safe communities
official_sources.gate: Policy support or facility proximity is not evidence of spare capacity, guaranteed delivery or development permission.

official_sources.name: National design guide
official_sources.gate: National design guidance is not a local/site-specific design code, permission or evidence a particular scheme complies.

official_sources.name: Design: process and tools planning guidance
official_sources.gate: A design tool, review or generic design principle is not itself an adopted local rule or permission for a specific proposal.

official_sources.name: National Model Design Code
official_sources.gate: The national model is guidance and must not be treated as an automatically applicable site-specific local design code.

official_sources.name: National Model Design Code part 1 coding process
official_sources.gate: A model-code recommendation is not proof a local code is adopted or that its numerical parameters apply to a target parcel.

official_sources.name: Creating a design code overview
official_sources.gate: A design-code framework or area type cannot be promoted to exact parcel requirements without the live local code and coding plan.

official_sources.name: Guidance on design code contents
official_sources.gate: Template content is not evidence that a local authority adopted any particular rule, measurement or threshold.

official_sources.name: NPPF chapter 12: achieving well-designed places
official_sources.gate: National expectation to prepare codes is not proof a target site is covered by an adopted code or satisfies it.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code specification
official_sources.gate: Specification compliance structures data but does not prove legal adoption, current status or exact spatial coverage of a local code.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code dataset
official_sources.gate: MHCLG-created platform records must not be treated as authoritative local policy without checking the source document and status.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code area dataset
official_sources.gate: Platform area geometry is screening evidence only until reconciled with the authoritative coding plan and live code.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code status dataset
official_sources.gate: A status taxonomy does not prove that any specific code has a particular current legal or policy status.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code area type dataset
official_sources.gate: Area-type classification is not a parcel-specific code rule, planning allocation or permission.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code characteristic dataset
official_sources.gate: Characteristic labels do not establish an adopted numeric rule or exact site requirement.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code rule dataset
official_sources.gate: Platform rules cannot be assumed authoritative or applicable to a parcel without linking to the exact adopted local code and area.

official_sources.name: Planning Data design code rule category dataset
official_sources.gate: A rule category is a schema classification, not a binding site rule or development approval.

official_sources.name: Planning Data enterprise zone research
official_sources.gate: Enterprise-zone research or national-scale mapping must not be used as exact parcel geometry or proof of a Local Development Order.

official_sources.name: Planning Data educational establishment dataset
official_sources.gate: A school point or capacity field does not prove catchment access, spare places, future expansion or infrastructure delivery for a development.

official_sources.name: Planning Data educational establishment consideration
official_sources.gate: Planning-consideration status does not prove sufficient school capacity or a site-specific education contribution requirement.

official_sources.name: Planning Data development corporation boundary dataset
official_sources.gate: Boundary overlap identifies potential planning governance but does not establish the exact powers, current jurisdiction or planning outcome for a parcel.

official_sources.name: Planning Data development corporation dataset
official_sources.gate: Organisation presence does not prove current parcel jurisdiction, site allocation or permission.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project dataset
official_sources.gate: An infrastructure-project boundary is not a fixed land-take boundary, DCO grant, construction status or delivered capacity.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project type dataset
official_sources.gate: A project-type category does not prove an actual project exists near a parcel or provides usable capacity.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project event dataset
official_sources.gate: An event taxonomy does not establish that a named project reached any particular stage or received consent.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project decision dataset
official_sources.gate: Decision-category availability is not proof of the decision status of any specific project.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project document type dataset
official_sources.gate: Document-type taxonomy does not prove a DCO or decision notice exists for a specific project.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project document dataset
official_sources.gate: Zero platform rows means NO_DATA and must not be interpreted as absence of project documents or consent evidence.

official_sources.name: Planning Data infrastructure project log dataset
official_sources.gate: Zero rows means NO_DATA, not proof that a project has no procedural history or activity.

official_sources.name: UK Modern Industrial Strategy collection
official_sources.gate: National sector prioritisation is macroeconomic policy and must not be converted into parcel-level demand, planning permission or infrastructure readiness.

official_sources.name: Industrial Strategy policy paper
official_sources.gate: National investment strategy does not prove local occupier demand, site viability, land control, utilities capacity or consent.

official_sources.name: Industrial Strategy sector definitions list
official_sources.gate: Sector classification is not a parcel suitability score and overlapping definitions must not be double-counted as demand.

official_sources.name: Industrial Strategy quarterly update April to June 2026
official_sources.gate: National delivery milestones or investment announcements are not evidence that a specific parcel has committed investment or development readiness.

official_sources.name: UK Modern Industrial Strategy year one
official_sources.gate: Programme-level commitments must not be assigned to a target site without exact project, location and delivery evidence.

official_sources.name: Industrial Strategy Prospectus
official_sources.gate: A national prospectus is strategic context, not proof of parcel-specific commercial demand, funding or planning status.
